records.key: Calibrated cell measurement was cancelled; no result was published.
records.source: Calibrated cell measurement was cancelled; no result was published.
records.translation: 보정된 세포 측정이 취소되었습니다. 결과는 게시되지 않았습니다.

records.key: Choose a new destination directory; existing results are never replaced.
records.source: Choose a new destination directory; existing results are never replaced.
records.translation: 새 대상 디렉터리를 선택하세요. 기존 결과는 절대 대체되지 않습니다.

records.key: Recorded pixel spacing cannot represent positive finite pixel areas and finite measurement coordinates.
records.source: Recorded pixel spacing cannot represent positive finite pixel areas and finite measurement coordinates.
records.translation: 기록된 픽셀 간격으로는 양수인 유한 픽셀 면적과 유한 측정 좌표를 표현할 수 없습니다.

records.key: Save calibrated measurements outside the input dataset.
records.source: Save calibrated measurements outside the input dataset.
records.translation: 보정된 측정값은 입력 데이터셋 바깥에 저장하세요.

records.key: Signed camera-linear estimates at the recorded common PSF; these are not concentrations or original-resolution dye amounts.
records.source: Signed camera-linear estimates at the recorded common PSF; these are not concentrations or original-resolution dye amounts.
records.translation: 기록된 공통 PSF에서 카메라 선형 척도의 부호를 보존한 추정값이며, 농도나 원래 해상도에서의 염료량이 아닙니다.

records.key: Signed cell measurement loading requires POSIX descriptor-relative file access without symbolic links; this platform is not supported.
records.source: Signed cell measurement loading requires POSIX descriptor-relative file access without symbolic links; this platform is not supported.
records.translation: 부호를 보존한 세포 측정값을 불러오려면 심볼릭 링크 없는 POSIX 디스크립터 기준 상대 파일 접근이 필요합니다. 이 플랫폼은 지원되지 않습니다.

records.key: Signed cell measurements require a completed cell-role dataset with matching signed float32 pixels, masks and calibration provenance. Regenerate older or inconsistent outputs.
records.source: Signed cell measurements require a completed cell-role dataset with matching signed float32 pixels, masks and calibration provenance. Regenerate older or inconsistent outputs.
records.translation: 부호를 보존한 세포 측정에는 완료된 세포 역할 데이터셋이 필요하며, 부호를 보존한 float32 픽셀, 마스크, 보정 출처 정보가 일치해야 합니다. 이전 또는 일관되지 않은 출력을 다시 생성하세요.

records.key: Sum of signed cell pixel values without pixel-area scaling or additional background subtraction.
records.source: Sum of signed cell pixel values without pixel-area scaling or additional background subtraction.
records.translation: 픽셀 면적을 곱하거나 배경을 추가로 빼지 않은, 부호를 보존한 세포 픽셀 값의 합입니다.

records.key: The calibrated dataset contains no completed fields to measure.
records.source: The calibrated dataset contains no completed fields to measure.
records.translation: 보정된 데이터셋에 측정할 완료된 이미지 필드가 없습니다.

records.key: The calibrated measurement cancellation check must be callable.
records.source: The calibrated measurement cancellation check must be callable.
records.translation: 보정 측정의 취소 검사 항목은 호출 가능해야 합니다.

records.key: This platform cannot atomically publish a new calibrated measurement directory without replacing existing results.
records.source: This platform cannot atomically publish a new calibrated measurement directory without replacing existing results.
records.translation: 이 플랫폼에서는 기존 결과를 대체하지 않고 새 보정 측정 디렉터리를 원자적으로 게시할 수 없습니다.

records.key: Zero-based pixel indices with exclusive upper bounding-box indices. Micrometre coordinates use recorded spacing, not an absolute microscope stage position.
records.source: Zero-based pixel indices with exclusive upper bounding-box indices. Micrometre coordinates use recorded spacing, not an absolute microscope stage position.
records.translation: 0부터 시작하는 픽셀 인덱스이며 경계 상자의 상한 인덱스는 포함하지 않습니다. 마이크로미터 좌표는 기록된 간격을 사용하며 현미경 스테이지의 절대 위치가 아닙니다.

review_method: AI technical authoring and independent AI technical/language peer review against exact signed calibrated cell measurement source/context contracts. No human or native-speaker signoff.
